messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: The mirt() can treat missing at not random?
parts:
No. In fact, there are very few regression approaches which can deal with this problem directly (MNAR is generally a nightmare to deal with and requires a lot of faith on the investigators end regarding how to properly deal with it). If possible, MNAR generally is best assessed with some form of imputation and performing sensitivity analyses. 

Phil
